context:
# Goal
Turn the Busan Station Unity scene (Assets/ChooGuard/Scenes/FpsStation.unity, open in the Editor; Main owns every scene change) into a complete digital twin: no undeveloped space behind doors/openings, no walk-off voids, every public space on the official guides modeled from evidence. This is a RESUME (4th spawn of your lane): the previous agent was killed by a session interruption at ~14:02 (2026-09-25). READ FIRST, in this order: (1) `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/plan.md` (definition of done, lanes, coordination, interruption safety, rules, kit type contracts); (2) your progress file (path in your task) — it is the authoritative state; (3) the latest resume digest (path in your task: every step, last reasoning, last results of the killed agent; full transcript path inside for grep); (4) the older digest only if you need earlier detail. Continue from where it stopped; never redo finished work. References: `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/kit-spec.md` (kit types), `.planning/2026-09-25-interior-enhance/verification.json` (previous round).

# Constraints
- Unity: you MAY run read-only renders (CaptureRegisteredScene.Calibrated) and `MajibangBuilder.KitValidate` on your own specs exactly as plan.md "Coordination" shows. NEVER any other unity command (no KitBuild, builder Main/FirstFloorInterior, eval, play mode, saves). Main builds.
- Evidence tiers: a / a-failed / b are built; c is reported only. Positions from registered or topological evidence (registered cameras/SfM fits, registered boards/vector plans, source-model geometry, built units); appearance from the kit library once existence and position are evidenced. Label guesses [INFERENCE]. Never invent positions.
- New data when evidence is missing (web search, official pages, Naver/Kakao, blogs, YouTube walks via `yt-dlp` ≤720p, `ffmpeg` frames) under `asset-library/research-public/2026-09-26/<Lane>/` with `receipts.json`. Disk: 14 GiB free now; ≤600 MB new data per lane; check `df -g .` before large writes; delete intermediates; never keep data only in /tmp.
- Interruption safety: update your progress file after every milestone and at least every ~10 tool calls (done with paths / evidence / decisions / exact next steps). Deliver incrementally: `write agent://Main` as soon as any spec (even a first subset) passes check_spec + KitValidate.
- Registration: pycolmap 4.2 + kornia + lightglue in `.tools/regtech/venv/bin/python` (system torch 2.13 MPS visible); RegTech's tool `.tools/regtech/register.py` (use it when `.tools/regtech/READY` exists). Naver indoor lon/lat -> station UV: `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/full/public1f/naver-1f-uv.json` (+ `register_naver.py`); per-floor Naver POIs with names: `asset-library/research-public/2026-09-26/Services23F/naver-indoor-harvest/` (README) and `asset-library/research-public/2026-09-26/Public1F/naver-poi/`.
- Official 2F guide orientation: RIGHT edge = U- (south), top = east, left = north (U+), bottom = west/plaza.
- Protected source `FPSWorld/*` is never edited; report needed openings (evidence + exact region) to Main.
- Frame: station UVY, model units; world x = u*sin16.2 + v*cos16.2, z = u*cos16.2 - v*sin16.2. Floors: 1F Y0; 2F Y7.0 (slab underside 6.7); 3F Y12.2; platform-side deck Y7.0. Box frame origin (-3.0, 33.25), rot 4.13°. Live geometry now: `.planning/2026-09-23-video-twin/1f-implementation/geometry-after18` (check_spec default; Main announces after19 once shop interiors are built — shop interiors stay inside the units). Built since your previous run: `실내 트윈 마감/바닥 보정` (75 Slab infill strips between the 2F/3F cell floor and the facades, tops at level-.005) and 9 builder shop fixture blocks removed (SHOP-FIX). Void scan: `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/voidscan2/` (`voidscan2.json` on after17, `triage.json` owners, maps `voidscan2-{0,7,12}.png`).
- Skip formatters/linters/project-wide tests.

# Contract
- Specs: `{"zone": "<unique zone>", "root": "실내 트윈 마감/<name>", "basis", "elements": [...]}` from a deterministic generator in `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/full/`. Zone names unique across roots (KitBuild enforces `.planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/kit-folders.json`). Validate: `/opt/homebrew/bin/python3 .planning/2026-09-24-interior-twin/specs/enhance/check_spec.py <spec>` (0 errors) and KitValidate (0 errors). `"replaces"` only with a builder-plan edit request. Kit types: the 22 in kit-spec.md plus Slab, Room, ToiletRoom, Window, Canopy (conventions: `.planning/2026-09-26-full-twin/progress/KitExtend3.md`; Room/ToiletRoom walls built inward from the polygon edges, floor overlay at y+.004, ToiletRoom entry = open gap 1.2 x 2.3, walls y..wallTop (default y1); Canopy underside y, fascia; Slab top exactly y).
- Messaging ids this round: SeamPassage4, PlatformSide4, Public1F4, Services23F4, RegTech4, KitExtend4, Main (`write agent://<id>`).
- Final answer: spec paths, generator, report JSON (each item → built / fixed / still-c with sources tried), receipts, overlay PNG, renders made, requests for Main (plan edits, protected-source decisions).
